item.description:
EasyReels 0.3.0

Exports finish almost instantly, and there is a lot more to do with the background.

  • Clips render while you read them. The encoder used to sit idle during the review and then make you wait. Now the work is done by the time you press Export, which is usually just a file copy.
  • Your own image or video behind the speaker, looped for as long as the clip runs. Gradients too.
  • The block behind the spoken word can be coloured. It never could be — the picker for it was missing.
  • Zoom goes below 1.0x, which is the only way a background shows at 16:9.
  • Optionally hand the transcript to Claude or ChatGPT instead of Apple Intelligence. Off by default: those read the whole sermon at once rather than in eight passes, but they cost money and the transcript leaves your Mac.

EasyReels 0.2.0

  • Settings now shows which version you're running, under Updates.

EasyReels 0.1.0

First release. Drop in a sermon — or a whole service — and get back vertical clips ready to post.

  • Transcribes on your Mac, then asks Apple Intelligence which moments stand on their own.
  • Handles a whole service: the worship set and the announcements are skipped, and only the preaching is searched.
  • Keeps the preacher in frame, burns in captions with the spoken word highlighted, and exports 9:16, 4:5, 1:1 or 16:9.
  • Title cards in four looks, your church logo and colours, saved as presets.
  • Writes the blog post, devotional, discussion guide, social posts and quotes to go with the clips.
  • Nothing is uploaded anywhere.

First launch: macOS will block it once. Open System Settings › Privacy & Security and click Open Anyway. You only do this once — updates never ask again.
